name: 86 Chaos 17.0.24
label: 86 Chaos 17.0.24
notes: Adds a Clear Month action in Schedule Builder that removes every saved shift in the displayed month only after explicit confirmation.
The confirmation states that both draft and published shifts will be deleted while events and time-off requests remain unchanged.
The clear operation reloads and verifies the restaurant month from Firestore, retries any remaining shift records once, and reports an error instead of silently leaving a partial clear.
Preserves the 17.0.23 Request Off cutoff/blackout policy and all unrelated application behavior.
title: 86 Chaos 17.0.24
summary: Schedule Builder can now clear all saved shifts from the displayed month with explicit destructive confirmation.
description: Adds a verified Clear Month control to Schedule Builder for deleting all draft and published shifts in the displayed month without deleting events or Request Off records.
